mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord {2}{B} loyalty 4
# [+1] "Target creature you control gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn. If it's a
#      Vampire, put a +1/+1 counter on it."
#      Loyalty cost: CostLoyalty(delta=1) (M21 Garruk, Unleashed / Basri Ket). The two keyword
#      grants repeat one TARGET selector, as the compiler writes "target creature ... gets X and
#      gains Y" (M21 Ranger's Guile, Garruk, Unleashed's +1) and "gain hexproof and indestructible"
#      (Heroic Intervention). "If it's a Vampire" is a bare characteristics-only Conditional,
#      judged on the object the grant step acted on (GRANT_ABILITY writes the result register since
#      79e7447); "it" = the targeted creature (referent 'target', Alchemist's Gift).
# [+1] "You may sacrifice a Vampire. When you do, Sorin deals 3 damage to any target and you gain
#      3 life."  Seq(OptionalEffect(SACRIFICE), Conditional(MAY_DONE, ...)): the M21 Dire Fleet
#      Warmonger "you may sacrifice ... If you do" shape, so nothing happens unless a Vampire was
#      sacrificed (OptionalEffect(Seq(SACRIFICE, damage, life)) deals the damage with no Vampire:
#      stronger than printed). Any target: Chandra, Heart of Fire's B5c-loyalty-chandra-dmg-any.
# [-3] "You may put a Vampire creature card from your hand onto the battlefield."
#      OptionalEffect over Ugin's hand -> battlefield MOVE_ZONE, one card.
creature_you_control = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
    filter=FAnd(
        children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
        ),
    ),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
the_target = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
    filter=FAnd(children=()),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
    referent='target',
)
vampire = FAnd(
    children=(
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Vampire'),
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    ),
)
plus1_grant = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostLoyalty(delta=1),)),
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.DEATHTOUCH),
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': creature_you_control,
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.LIFELINK),
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': creature_you_control,
            }),
            Conditional(
                pred=vampire,
                then_effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
                    'count': QConst(value=1),
                    'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
                    'target': the_target,
                }),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
plus1_sacrifice = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostLoyalty(delta=1),)),
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            OptionalEffect(
                inner=A(Verb.SACRIFICE, {
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                        filter=FAnd(
                            children=(
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Vampire'),
                                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            ),
                        ),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
            # "When you do": a reflexive trigger (CR 603.12), its any-target slot chosen as it
            # goes on the stack, after the sacrifice (the sacrificed Vampire is gone by then).
            Conditional(
                pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.MAY_DONE),
                then_effect=DelayedTrigger(duration=None, event=None, condition=None, effect=Seq(
                    steps=(
                        A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
                            'amount': QConst(value=3),
                            'target': Selector(
                                count=QConst(value=1),
                                mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                                filter=FOr(
                                    children=(
                                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Planeswalker'),
                                        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Player'),
                                    ),
                                ),
                                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                            ),
                        }),
                        A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=3), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
                    ),
                )),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
minus3 = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostLoyalty(delta=-3),)),
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=vampire,
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [plus1_grant, plus1_sacrifice, minus3, *compiled]

clauses.clause: [+1]: Target creature you control gains deathtouch and lifelink until end of turn.
If it's a Vampire, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
When you do, Sorin deals 3 damage to any target and you gain 3 life.
[−3]: You may put a Vampire creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.

mapping.notes: Was needs-atom (ENGINE: SACRIFICE took the target; GRANT wrote no result); both fixed on fix/w2-effects. 'When you do' (a reflexive trigger, CR 603.12) is written as the If-you-do gate Seq(OptionalEffect(SACRIFICE), Conditional(MAY_DONE, ...)) with its any-target slot chosen at activation, as the compiler's 'When you do' (Tolarian Kraken) chooses targets up front; the earlier OptionalEffect(Seq(...)) shape dealt 3 and gained 3 with no Vampire (pack_sac_novamp). Engine quirk: targeting the Vampire you then sacrifice marks the 3 damage on the card in the graveyard. 2026-11-12 (trigger lane): 'When you do' is a reflexive trigger (CR 603.12): the If-you-do gate now holds DelayedTrigger(duration=None, event=None, ...), so its any-target slot is chosen as it goes on the stack after the sacrifice (the verified wave-1 finding: the Vampire being sacrificed was offered as a target, and a targeting event fired when the sacrifice was declined). The record's ir and draft changed with it; its verified stamp (if any) no longer matches, so it is verified again before it is dealt.
